timeline.text: A Ukrainian story mentions a Norwegian town, and the name comes out wrong — forced into Cyrillic, nothing like a Norwegian would say it.
Odd — the app already had a real Norwegian voice saying that same name correctly, elsewhere in the story.
Now the AI marks every Norwegian name instead of translating it.
The audio pipeline splices that real recording right into the Ukrainian sentence.
The fix went back into every story already published too — rewritten in batches of eight.
